[Warning] IA/IA4 — Search, filters and page live only in component state; the URL never reflects the filtered view. Flagged by: IA4, N6. Noted.

[Warning] Accessibility/A10 — Row is unlabelled spans; direction carried only by bare "→" glyphs, unlabelled color dot, no list semantics. Noted.
[Warning] Accessibility/A5 — Dialog disclosure buttons lack aria-expanded/aria-controls. Noted.

## 2026-08-10 — EventTypeSettingsTable (audit)

**Critical:** 5 · **Warnings:** 10 · **Suggestions:** 5
**Action taken:** Report shown, no fixes

### Findings

- [Critical] accessibility/A5 — Create-row name `<Input>` has only a `placeholder`, no accessible name (WCAG 4.1.2). Noted.

- [Warning] content-design/C4 (+CW-Q1) — empty state is a bare `—` with no context and no action. Noted.
- [Warning] heuristics/N9 (+NM4) — mutation handlers use `try/finally` with no `catch`; a network rejection produces no feedback. Noted.
- [Warning] content-design/C3 — `save_failed` / `delete_failed` name the failure but no recovery and no reassurance that input is preserved. Noted.
- [Warning] heuristics/N4 (+G2) — the `X` icon means both "delete event type" and "cancel edit" on the same surface. Noted.
- [Warning] heuristics/N3 (+NM5) — an assigned colour cannot be unset; the picker emits only hex although schema/API/render all support null. Noted.
- [Warning] accessibility/A5 (+F5) — colour swatches announce as raw hex and form an ungrouped 12-tab-stop `aria-pressed` set instead of a labelled radio group. Noted.
- [Warning] platform/Touch-First (+A8) — `size="sm"` (32px) icon actions and 24px swatches at `gap-2`; no `pointer: coarse` block anywhere in globals.css. Noted.
- [Warning] platform/Mental-Model-Rule (Attribution) — no attribution or change trail on event types; no ActivityLog write in the API, no `created_by_id` in the model. Noted (recommendation-only, needs schema change).
- [Warning] responsive/R3 — edit/create rows put the 12-swatch picker in the `w-8` colour column and `colSpan={2}` the name input, breaking header alignment. Noted.
- [Warning] content-design/C8 — `in_use_toast` has no plural handling; reads ungrammatically at count 1 in the primary locale. Noted.
- [Suggestion] design-system/DS5 — `AlertDialogAction` re-declares the destructive classes instead of `buttonVariants({ variant: "destructive" })`. Noted.
- [Suggestion] design-system/DS5 (+V2) — the surface's primary action renders as `variant="outline" size="sm"` while row-level Save uses the primary variant. Noted.
- [Suggestion] heuristics/N7 — no sort, filter, or search on an authority list that grows unbounded. Noted.
- [Suggestion] heuristics/N10 — no explanation of what an event type is or why deletion is blocked. Noted.
- [Suggestion] information-architecture/IA4 — the in-use toast action uses `window.location.href`, forcing a full document reload. Noted.

## 2026-08-10 — reset-password (audit)

**Critical:** 3 · **Warnings:** 9 · **Suggestions:** 3
**Action taken:** Report shown, no fixes

### Findings

[Critical] Heuristics/N9 (+IA8, C3/C4, CW-Q4) — Missing/invalid-token branch is a terminal dead end: one sentence, no link to re-request or sign in, and no nav in the auth chrome. Noted.
[Critical] Content/C3 (+N9, C8, A7, N4; severity raised: corroborated by 5 lenses) — Client zod schema is module-scope with no `t()` messages: password errors render English zod defaults ("String must contain at least 8 character(s)", "Invalid") and the mismatch error renders the raw key `auth.errors.passwordMismatch`. Measured against zod 3.25.76. Noted.
[Critical] Accessibility/A1 (+platform Touch-First, L1) — Password reveal toggle is a 16×16 target (no padding, `h-4 w-4` icon); WCAG 2.5.8 requires 24×24, platform requires 44×44 on coarse pointers. Noted.
[Warning] Content/C3 (+N9) — Expired and already-used tokens both return TOKEN_EXPIRED and read "Der Link ist abgelaufen"; a user who already reset is looped back to request another link. Noted.
[Warning] Heuristics/N9 (+IA8, N3) — Every failure banner is text-only with no recovery control; the expired-token arrival has no path back to forgot-password. Noted.
[Warning] Heuristics/N9 (+C3) — 429 (rate limit, 5/15min) and 400 VALIDATION_FAILED (malformed 64-hex token) both fall through to "Ein Fehler ist aufgetreten. Bitte versuche es erneut."; `errors.rateLimited` exists and is unused. Noted.
[Warning] Heuristics/N6 (+A7, F1) — The five-rule password policy is enforced but never stated; no help text, and the meter never names what is missing. Noted.
[Warning] Heuristics/N2 (+C1) — Strength meter labels policy satisfaction as "Sehr stark"; `Aa1!aaaa` scores 5/5. Overclaims for a Rigorous brand and a skeptical audience. Noted.
[Warning] DesignSystem/DS1 (+DS2) — Strength bars use `bg-red-500`…`bg-green-500` primitives where `--color-destructive/warning/success` exist with light+dark variants; the bars do not re-tone in dark mode. Noted.
[Warning] Accessibility/A6 — Filled strength segments fail 3:1 in light theme (measured: yellow 1.89, lime 1.93, green 2.20, orange 2.86 vs `--color-card`). Graded Warning not Critical because the adjacent text label duplicates the information. Noted.
[Warning] Content/C8 (+A5) — Reveal-toggle `aria-label` is hardcoded English ("Show password"/"Hide password") on a German-default product. Noted.
[Warning] Accessibility/A4 (+A10) — Shared auth chrome: no `<main>` landmark, and `CardTitle` is a `<div>` so "Neues Passwort" is not a heading; the only h1 is the wordmark. Corroborates sibling reviewers. Noted.
[Suggestion] IA/IA4 (+C8) — `router.push("/auth/login?reset=1")` drops the locale prefix under `localePrefix: "always"`; an /en user without a NEXT_LOCALE cookie likely lands on /de. Inferred from routing config, not measured. Noted.
[Suggestion] Forms/F5 — No hidden `autocomplete="username"` field, so password managers cannot bind the new credential. Noted.
[Suggestion] Heuristics/G2 (+N4) — Only the first password field has a reveal toggle; the confirm field, the more error-prone one on mobile, does not. Noted.

- [Warning] Platform/i18n (+C8) — `aria-label="Show password" / "Hide password"` hardcoded English on the de-default surface. Noted.
- [Warning] Platform/i18n (+C8) — `aria-label="Language switcher"` hardcoded English in LocaleSwitcher. Noted.
- [Warning] Accessibility/A4 (+A10) — No `<main>` landmark in the auth layout (none anywhere in `src/app/`). Noted.
- [Warning] Accessibility/A10 — Page title "Anmelden" renders as a `<div>` via CardTitle; the only heading is `<h1>Evidoxa</h1>`. Noted.
- [Warning] Platform/Touch-First — LocaleSwitcher buttons compute to ~34×24 px; meets A1 but not the 44×44 coarse-pointer rule, and globals.css has no `pointer: coarse` target block. Noted.
- [Warning] Design-system/DS1 (+DS2) — Both status banners bypass the semantic token tier: hardcoded `bg-green-50/text-green-800` + manual `dark:` variants, and `bg-destructive/10`, where success/destructive background+foreground+border tokens are defined. Noted.
- [Suggestion] Content-design/C3 (+C1) — `errors.serverError` ("Ein Fehler ist aufgetreten…") names a recovery but not what happened; brand voice asks for both. Noted.
- [Suggestion] Content-design/C8 — Login zod schema is defined at module scope with no `t()` messages, so any rendered validation error would be English zod defaults. Noted.

- [Suggestion] Content-design/C8 — "Noch kein Konto?" is concatenated with the register link as a sentence fragment; fragile under locale reordering. Noted.

## 2026-08-10 — ForgotPasswordPage (`src/app/[locale]/(auth)/auth/forgot-password/page.tsx`) (audit)

**Critical:** 3 · **Warnings:** 9 · **Suggestions:** 3
**Action taken:** Report shown, no fixes

_Reconstructed by the auditor from the reviewer's returned report — the reviewer completed its cascade but did not write its own entry before finishing._

### Findings

[Critical] Heuristics/N1+N9 (+forms F6) — ForgotPasswordForm.tsx:37-47 `onSubmit` never inspects `res.ok`/`res.status` and the `catch` sets the success state, so a 429 (the route rate-limits 3/hour per IP+email), a 400, a 500 and an offline device all render "you will receive a link". Enumeration is already closed server-side (route.ts:44-48,85 returns an identical 200 either way), so suppressing client failures only misleads. Severity raised: corroborated by 3 lenses. Noted.
[Critical] Content/C1+C5 (+CW-Q4) — `auth.forgot.emailSentMessage` states a conditional and nothing else: no delivery window, no spam hint, no retry path, no mention that the token expires in one hour. Brand voice requires "state what happened, then what the user can do about it"; only the hedged first half is present. Severity raised: corroborated by 3 lenses. Noted.
[Critical] Accessibility/A5+A10 — ForgotPasswordForm.tsx:50-56 the success block has no `role="status"`/`aria-live` (WCAG 2.2 4.1.3 failure), and focus was on the submit button which unmounts in the same render, dropping focus to `<body>`. Noted.
[Warning] IA/IA8 (+N3) — ForgotPasswordForm.tsx:50-56 the "Zurück zur Anmeldung" link lives inside the form and disappears with it; the success screen is an exit-less dead end. Noted.
[Warning] Heuristics/N1 (+IA7) — page.tsx:11 the card title never changes, so after submitting the heading still reads "Passwort vergessen?" above the sent message. The correct string `auth.forgot.emailSent` exists but is only ever returned as an unread API message code. Noted.
[Warning] Content/C8 — ForgotPasswordForm.tsx:15-17 `forgotSchema` is at module scope with no `t()`, so `errors.email.message` renders zod's English default "Invalid email" in the German UI. ResetPasswordForm.tsx:29 shows the project's own convention. Noted.
[Warning] Accessibility/A5 — ForgotPasswordForm.tsx:63-70 the input sets `aria-invalid` but the error paragraph has no `id` and the input no `aria-describedby`; the message is not in a live region. Noted.
[Warning] Platform/Touch-First — ForgotPasswordForm.tsx:76-80 the back link is a ~20px inline target, below the overlay's 44×44 coarse-pointer minimum. Noted.
[Warning] Platform/Touch-First — ui/button.tsx:21 the shadcn default size is `h-10` (40px), under the same minimum. Cross-surface shared component — dedupe at aggregation. Noted.
[Warning] Accessibility/A4+A10 — (auth)/layout.tsx:11-16 is `<div>`-only; no `<main>` landmark on any auth surface. Cross-surface shared chrome. Noted.
[Warning] Accessibility/A10 — ui/card.tsx:23-32 `CardTitle` renders a `<div>`, so the page's only heading is the `<h1>Evidoxa</h1>` wordmark. Noted.
[Suggestion] Forms/F1 — ForgotPasswordForm.tsx:29-32 validation runs in default `onSubmit` mode; no on-blur pass on a single-field form where a typo causes silent non-delivery. Noted.
[Suggestion] Motion/M4 (+N1) — ForgotPasswordForm.tsx:72-75 pending state is a spinner plus `disabled` with no `aria-busy` and no label change; under the global reduced-motion reset the spinner freezes. M5 itself passes. Noted.
[Suggestion] Responsive/R4 — (auth)/layout.tsx:6,11 uses `min-h-screen` (100vh) twice rather than `min-h-dvh`. Cross-surface shared chrome. Noted.

### Not raised

No ethics findings — a single email field is minimal collection (E7 clean), no consent UX, no dark pattern; the ambiguous success copy is a security decision, reported under content/heuristics rather than as deception. Contrast measured, not assumed: `--color-destructive` on `--color-card` computes to ~5.55:1 light / ~4.96:1 dark, both passing AA.
